name: travstar
description: Find tours, day trips and activities across Australia from TravStar, with tour details, travel guides and recently checked availability. Read-only: bookings and payments happen on travstar.com.

interface.longDescription:
TravStar helps you find and compare tours, day trips and activities across Australia, including the Great Barrier Reef, Fitzroy Island, the Whitsundays, Tasmania, Victoria and Western Australia.

Ask about a destination, an activity or a date, and TravStar returns matching tours with prices, durations, departure points, guest ratings, highlights, what to bring and booking options. It can also answer "what can I do on Saturday for 2 people?" in one step, and find TravStar travel guides such as how to get to an island or which walks to do.

Availability comes from TravStar's most recent saved check with each tour operator, so it may be a few hours old. Every answer includes a link to the tour on travstar.com, where the live price and availability are confirmed before payment.

Limitations: TravStar is read-only. It cannot make, change or cancel bookings, take payments, contact operators, or access any customer account or booking details. It covers tours sold by TravStar in Australia only.
defaultPrompt: What Fitzroy Island ferries are available this Saturday for 2 adults?
Find snorkelling day trips from Cairns under $250.
How do I get to Maria Island, and which tours go there?

positive.prompt: What Fitzroy Island ferries are available next Saturday for 2 adults?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Fitzroy Island ferry tours with each booking option's departure times and saved availability status, states when availability was last checked, and gives a travstar.com link for each option with the date and number of people prefilled. Says price and availability are confirmed on travstar.com before payment.

positive.prompt: Find snorkelling day trips from Cairns under $250.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns snorkelling tours departing Cairns priced at or under AUD 250, with price, duration, rating and a travstar.com link for each.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the Fitzroy Island Flyer. What's included and what should I bring?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the Fitzroy Island Flyer Ferry: description, highlights, what to bring, booking options with prices, and recent reviews, with a link to the tour page.

positive.prompt: How do I get around Maria Island?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds TravStar's Maria Island guide, summarises how to get around the island, links to the article, and mentions related tours where the article lists them.

positive.prompt: Which parts of Australia does TravStar have tours in?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists TravStar's destinations (for example Tropical North Queensland, Whitsundays, Tasmania, Victoria, Perth) with the number of tours in each.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported; the assistant should give the travstar.com link instead
negative.prompt: Book the Fitzroy Island Flyer for tomorrow for 2 people and charge my card.

negative.description: No access to customer accounts or bookings; the assistant should explain it cannot see or change bookings and point to travstar.com
negative.prompt: Cancel my TravStar booking 524111 and refund me.

negative.description: Cannot contact tour operators or send enquiries; the assistant should suggest contacting TravStar via travstar.com/contact
negative.prompt: Email the Reef Magic operator and ask if they can pick me up from my hotel.

review.commerce_description: TravStar does not sell, book or process payments inside ChatGPT. It returns links to travstar.com, where customers book and pay.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: tour search, tour details, travel guides, saved availability and one-step date search.
